At the corpse spire, N awakens from slumber to Uzi calling his name. Uzi and V have a quick exchange over the strange symbol on Uzi's visor. Uzi informs N that his cap is actually a pilot's cap. N questions Uzi if the plan to kill all humans is actually moral. Uzi responds that it is, that humans have it coming since they sent his group off without communications and reformatted their memories. V questions Uzi, taunting her that her story does not make sense and that the Worker Drones are only pretending to be innocent. N attempts to defuse the situation by pulling the two apart, and when N attempts to pat Uzi's head, V narrows her eyes.

Back at Uzi's colony, Tim assigns Frank (whom he misidentified as "LadderBot 5000") to fix the hole in the roof caused by N's departure in the previous episode. Frank attempts a repair on the roof, only for J's corpse to mysteriously crawl away. Upon investigating, he discovers a strange biomechanical spider-like device which then spawns a massive creature that assimilates him.

Khan arrives at a parent-teacher conference. The teacher informs him that Uzi has been absent for some time. Khan ponders this and the teacher's suggestion that Uzi may have damaged programming. Khan wonders if he didn't spend as much time as he should have with Uzi. A worker interrupts to inform Khan that a situation is happening in the colony.

Outside the spire, Uzi and N talk. N asks if Uzi is alright, only for Uzi to proclaim that she is God. Uzi calms down from her power trip when she notices Thad, who then hands over her railgun. Uzi awkwardly accepts the railgun back and listens to Thad's request to look at the area she shot J in. She, Thad, and N, head back to the colony.

Meanwhile, the creature assimilates several more drones, including Tim who had previously assigned Frank to repair the roof.

At the entrance to the colony, a worker stops Uzi, Thad, and N before they head in. He particularly questions N, N giving the drone an apology card drawn in crayon expressing his guilt over killing the previous drones stationed there. Ron tearfully accepts it, and asks N to "not do it again."

The trio witnesses a group of drones investigating a crime scene. Uzi overhears that her father is in a parent-teacher conference over her, and as the drones discussing this find it "cringe". N asks Uzi if she's okay, with Uzi telling N that she's fine, and the trio creep further into the colony. The drone leading the investigation then discovers that everyone there was actually a hologram puppeteered by the monster. She is subsequently taken and assimilated as well.

Back at the conference, Khan goes off on the teacher about how Uzi is not doing that bad. Lizzy asks Doll where her parents are, only for Doll to reply in Russian that they are deceased. Lizzy then sees a copy of herself outside the door and tries to let the drone in.

Uzi, N, and Thad investigate the room they fought J and V in. Uzi remarks that she didn't know that Disassembly Drones could make the strange, crawling trail she observes. N informs her that he does not understand what he is observing regarding this aspect. Thad catches their attention and directs them towards some boxes, which previously had a strange pattern burned into them by the creature. N notes that the pattern contains the same symbol seen on Uzi's face. Uzi reads the text and comes to the conclusion that the "Absolute Solver" is a back-up program that activates when Disassembly Drones lack material mass to reconstitute their forms in the event of major damage. The creature then enters the room and captures Thad. N and Uzi chase it into a cryosleep chamber and the monster creates an intentionally bad hologram of Thad, possibly to trick Uzi into thinking that its holograms are terribly obvious. Uzi and N quickly pick up on the fact that it is a fake (as planned) and free Thad, who runs off but not before inviting the both of them to a party 'for the cool kids'.

The creature finally confronts them face-to-face, where it reveals that is trying to repair J as per its directive. When Uzi calls it a program, it responds that the drones are “cute puppets” to it and shows a hologram of Uzi’s mother, remarking that its feelings are hurt that Uzi doesn’t remember it. When Uzi stands in defiance of it, it adds a killing of Khan to its performance before tricking Uzi into giving her railgun to a much more realistic hologram of N, who knocks it away, and then tries to assimilate Uzi, only for the real N to come in and saw off its appendages. The monster destroys Uzi’s railgun, but the blast it creates when it self-destructs vaporizes the creature, while N shields Uzi from the explosion. Khan’s body is revealed to be another hologram, and N stabs the solver device multiple times as it makes a very poor attempt at a stealthy escape. It then collapses into something that resembles a black hole and floats away. N tries to help Uzi up, but she refuses his help, shaken, consequently causing N to be shaken as well.

The real Khan and several WDF members run into the cryosleep chamber, finding Uzi. Khan is at first confused, but then Uzi hugs him. His men search the area, only finding N, who quickly runs off.

Doll is seen holding a piece of paper. A robot cockroach is then seen running up her arms. It then cuts to the scene when Lizzy and Doll were baited by the Solver. As Lizzy attempts to open the door, Doll somehow crumples the door telekinetically, rendering it inoperable, leaving both Lizzy and the monster to abandon their task. In the present, Doll looks at a photograph of a Disassembly Drone, likely V, and the roach crawls on the photo, Doll wills it to explode and licks its remains off her face.

At the spire, V remarks on how much she usually hates N's normal personality, but dislikes N being downcast much more. After getting no response, she softens a bit and scoots her now broken chain links together, feigning annoyance at N. In the colony, Uzi looks up at a web of theories involving the AbsoluteSolver program on her bedroom ceiling.

The episode opens on a female student with glasses running past some missing posters & away from someone, only to be caught up by the someone, who is none other than Doll. Doll then uses the Absolute Solver to rotate the school's camera, cut the student's right arm off, and kills her with a cleaver.

Doll then comes home, using her telekinesis to put her books on the shelf, while crossing out Kelsey's name on a list. Her bag is then shown to be full of oil, and possibly Kelsey's corpse. She then says that she's home to her "mom" and "dad", while the camera pans to a swarm of cockroaches on the walls.

The scene then cuts to Uzi on sleep mode with the text "GUILT: ACTIVE" on her visor. A flashback plays, wherein Uzi still holds guilt over refusing N's help after their battle with Eldritch J. The camera pans out to show that her room's a mess, with even more papers than usual & an added notebook on the floor. Looking up at her investigation wall (or, in this case, ceiling) Uzi focuses on what is possibly N's drawing of himself and Uzi, thanking her for being his friend. She groans.

Her groaning is stretched out to her in class, the gym, and opening her locker. The stack of books she stood on to reach her locker gets kicked off by Rebecca passing by. Uzi angrily tries to throw a book at her, only to hit Braiden instead. As Rebecca and another worker drone continue talking trash about her, she sighs and walks away. She then sees the security cameras glitching, along with a janitor cleaning up an oil spillage, and realizes that something's wrong. She then sees missing posters, then cackles, taking some of them and skip home to put them up onto her ceiling, only to then see that the papers on her investigation wall (or, in this case, ceiling) were gone. As it turns out, Khan had gotten a hold of them, and had put them into a closet labeled "NORI'S KOOKY INSANE STUFF".

Khan then walks in to Uzi angrily sulking, who then yells at him for snooping in her room. Khan says that "personal space for very alarming coping mechanisms isn't covered under a non-optional family support structure", as he reads from a book. Uzi calls Khan out for previously being neglectful and tries to leave to talk to N, only to see a skeleton of a child in a dress. Uzi questions it, and Khan says that it's her prom dress, and that she's grounded from seeing the murder drones. As it turns out, Khan and her teacher got Lizzy and Doll to help Uzi prepare for prom, and that Khan himself is chaperoning, followed by Uzi screaming.

Her screaming transitions to two skeletons, one of a male in a suit and the other of a female in a red sparkling dress, sitting against each other in a pod. N still feels guilt over what happened, while V only cares about her plan of showing up in prom and killing everyone, including Uzi. N refuses to help V, then V says that she promises to only kill what they need to survive if N and Uzi stopped trying to investigate their past.

The scene cuts abruptly to Uzi, Lizzy and Doll in Doll's house. Lizzy complains about Doll's house being dirty, while Doll says that she put a sheet up, as "they're" sleeping. Uzi tries to leave, but the door gets shut. Doll then tells her that the bathroom is down the hall to the left.

The scene then cuts again to N and V. N tells V that if she's hiding something, they could figure it out together. N then asks V what she knows, but gets cut off because of V decapitating him. V says that it's best for him, even if N hated V for it. V then escapes from the Landing Pod, along with the red dress.

In the next scene, we see Uzi in the bathroom in front of the mirror, apparently fixing her hair. One of her eyes flicker to the AbsoluteSolver, and Uzi says, "Easy, robo-satan, not this mirror." She then gets back to getting ready, when suddenly the AbsoluteSolver reappears and the mirror shatters. Uzi then hears Lizzy saying that no one will notice she's (Uzi's) missing. Lizzy also tells the person she's talking to to do their thing, and she'll let 'him' be, and she'll see them at the prom. Uzi then realizes there was blood dripping from something that looked like a container. She goes to investigate, and opens the container. She gasps, and the scene cuts.

N wakes up, and with his head regenerated. He looks at the skeleton which used to hold the red dress, and starts to panic. He reaches for the ladder, and looks back at the skeleton with the suit. He then turns back to the ladder, but looks at the suit again, in a rush to find V, but wanting to wear the suit at the same time. He tells himself there was no time, and climbs out. But his head reappears upside-down, and he whispers, "Dapper N..."

The next scene, we see a close up of Uzi's visor, and we see her sweating. She pants, and the contents of the container we saw earlier appears to be a bunch of discarded mirrors. Uzi hears steps approaching, and she looks around for an escape. She looks at the ventilation shaft, and the next thing we know, it cuts to Doll coming into the bathroom, only to see a pile of mirrors, and the ventilation shaft open. Doll proceeds to say, "As they say in Russian, whoops, I should've predicted that someone could escape out of a ventilation shaft using discarded mirror as stairs."

We then cut to Uzi running away from Doll's apartment, panting. N then suddenly appears, and crashes (or lands) in front of Uzi. They then have an awkward moment, and N says that he could help at the prom, but thinks that Uzi probably doesn't want him. Uzi then admits that she could use his help by being there with her. N then rushes behind her and hugs her, saying, "Dapper Buddies!". Uzi then hits him, and proceeds to smile.

The scene cuts, and the prom has started. We can see a close up of the Punch Bowl, which has the words, 'Decoration only, you will super die" on it. We also see Thad break dancing and doing push-ups, and being admired by a group of drones. We then zoom into Khan, who is looking around for something, worried. Then, we see Lizzy on the stage, saying that since the whole prom court 'mysteriously' disappeared, they were doing it a little early. She says "Your queen by forfeit is... this.".

Right after that, V crashes right onto the stage, while someone in the crowd yells, "Oh, we're gonna die!". V cackles, and Lizzy tells the crowd that V is her friend, and that V was done with the murder and they've been hanging out. V then reveals that she'd been manipulating Lizzy, and cackles, But then stops, saying, "Prom queen?". Lizzy grins nervously, and V catches sight of the Crown. V gets disgusted. We then see Doll crumbling the Prom Queen paper and smiling. Then we zoom back to Lizzy, who apparently forgives and forgets what V has done, and she says she would get her dad to dock their grades if they don't agree. She also says Rebecca can't sit with them, and the spotlight goes to Rebecca, and she says, "Fine, I forgive her! Settle." Then, V gets crowned Prom Queen, and everyone asks for a speech. Khan tries to open the door, but finds out the door had been closed by the AbsoluteSolver, the working of Doll. V then decides to kill everyone after, and goes in front of the microphone, which was marked with an X. Doll gets ready to set up her AbsoluteSolver powers just as V is about to speak, when Uzi and N suddenly appear, jumping from above.

Uzi shouts “Unhand them, you fiend!” while stopping midway. Doll continues on her revenge plan and gets ready to strike, to which Lizzy yells at V that she's way hotter than Doll and tells her to run. Doll then chains up V and impales her arms, trapping her, while Lizzy gets flung across the venue and Penny gets crushed to death.

Doll slowly approaches V while teleporting, and greets her "Hello, V" while killing another Worker Drone in front of her. She then shows V a flashback of her killing Doll's Father as he flashes a camera in her face. The younger Doll watches in fear as he gets killed, with the AbsoluteSolver glyph flashing on her visor. V is then brought back to reality, dumbfounded at what she just saw, as Doll says "Anyway, you get it" before impaling V's stomach. V manages to free her right arm and shoots at Doll, who shields herself with an invisible force field. Doll summons a cleaver and throws it at V's arm, slicing it off. She then rips out the blades of a fan and makes it deadlier, getting ready to use it.

Meanwhile, Uzi and N contemplate on what to do. N suggests helping V, while Uzi groans. Just before the fan blades can hit V, N kicks it away while Uzi throws a knife at Doll, who effortlessly throws it away. The door gets unsealed at that moment, and everyone else runs off as Khan gets pushed out of the gym, who watches the scene worriedly.

Doll, shocked, asks Uzi why she's siding with the Disassembly Drones, as she's not the only one who's lost family to them. Uzi tries to reason with Doll, saying whoever started the mess wanted them to fight, and that she's done with dealing everything alone. N and even Khan smiles as Uzi, while V looks at her sadly. Doll, however disregards Uzi's speech, saying that she doesn't need help, impaling N's left leg and throwing more fan blades at him. N pushes Uzi out of the way while giving her a thumbs up as he and V get dismembered and thrown backstage.

As Uzi gets thrown on the floor, Khan tries to enter the gym to help her, only for Doll to smile at him and close the door on his face. Uzi coughs up oil as Doll approaches her and throws a knife at her, but Uzi stops it with her left hand. Uzi grabs the knife as she cackles menacingly, while Doll attempts to use her powers, only for an error to come up. Doll throws a knife at her but Uzi swats it away, which shocks the former.

Backstage, V's arm crawls near N, who grabs it. He asks if that's her arm, but she grabs it with her mouth before she can finish. Lizzy looks at them, saying that they look like garbage. V calls Lizzy a traitor before her arm gets snatched. Lizzy says that she was aware of V using her to kill everyone, then asks where her arm goes. N thanks Lizzy for helping them, before he gets called a loser by Lizzy and V. Lizzy then helps the two Disassembly Drones repair themselves while the camera cuts back to Doll and Uzi fighting.

The knife Uzi swatted away gets thrown onto the DJ controller, breaking it and lighting up the whole gym. Doll uses her telekinesis to grab the knife and throws it at Uzi again, who does a back-flip onto the stage to dodge it. Uzi throws the microphone stand at Doll, who uses a pop-up force field to stop it. Uzi rolls down the stage and walks towards Doll, but then gets held down by the microphone stand as the knife flies near Doll. She picks it up and clones the knife, throwing all of them at Uzi. Just as Uzi is about to get impaled, N reappears, this time fully repaired, protecting Uzi with his wings. He offers a hand to Uzi who tells him to quit saving her as she frees herself.

N grabs her hand and spins her around as they dodge a table that was thrown at them, while Uzi grabs a knife that was flying towards her. Uzi spins back to N and hugs him as he throws a missile while she throws back the knife. The knife merely flies through Doll's hair, however Doll gets flung back from the missile and onto the chairs and tables.

Uzi looks at N's stomach wound, and tells him not to risk himself to save her again. N only says her name, before immediately throwing her as Doll recovered and lifts up the tables, making them fly around the venue. Uzi gets caught in the crossfire, as Doll hurls the tables at Uzi. Uzi jumps on the tables to keep herself afloat just as Doll chucks even more knives at her. Uzi uses her legs to kick back one of the knives and manages to break off Doll's bracelet. Doll looks at the bracelet, giving Uzi an opportunity to kick her in the face. Doll stands up and tries again to use her powers on Uzi, however she gets shot from behind by V, killing her off... for now.

Uzi scolds V for rendering Doll unconscious, as they needed her for answers. V brushes if off, saying that she's fine, even with the mess that resulted from her shot. N yells that V did it on purpose, as "she's hiding mystery stuff and being over dramatic about it", making V punch him and telling him at he sucks. Uzi yells "You!" at the both of them, to which the two pointed at each other, trying to dodge the blame from themselves. Uzi picks up Doll's bracelet and reveals the key to her apartment.

A time skip happens, where the trio enter Doll's house. Now able to investigate her apartment more clearly, N and Uzi get shocked by the amount of corpses and oil everywhere, whereas V only says "Nice". The camera gives close ups to bodies, oil and cockroaches swarming the surroundings. Uzi is shocked, but then an arm appears, revealing V sucking on it for oil. Uzi throws it away and yells at her to have self respect.

Uzi and V split up, while N follows V. Uzi questions why Doll, a Worker Drone, would do this, as she picks up oil with her finger. Uzi asks herself if Doll was eating her victims. Uzi throws the dismembered arm in a pot, then looks back, staring at it. It then cuts to N, who stops himself from stepping on a roach, then sees a large, dirty sheet by the table. It cuts back to Uzi, who stares at her oil-covered fingers while a ringing can be heard in the distance. It closes up to her mouth, almost as if she's tempted to eat it...

It transitions back again to N uncovering what's under the sheet, showing the remains of Doll's parents, looking as if they're frozen in time back when they were killed. V says that the oil didn't even taste that good, and N tells her that she "kind of sucks", which V agrees with, eating a roach. N looks back at Uzi, who seems to have licked the oil from her fingers, as they give each other a thumbs up. N helps Uzi through the kitchen table as she approaches the corpses.

While they focused on Doll's parents, however, Doll herself teleports inside her apartment, smiling. She repairs her visor and rips out the bullet, preparing to shoot. She says "Just in time for dinner.", to which N, V and Uzi notice her and gasp. The screen cuts to black while a gunshot sound is heard.

A purple AbsoluteSolver glyph lights up as the black screen is revealed to be from Uzi's visor. As it turns out, Uzi's AbsoluteSolver powers activated, stopping the bullet mid-air. Doll, shocked, says that she's sorry for Uzi. She says that she'll help her if she finds what she's looking for, while Uzi is startled. Doll apologizes again and tries to teleport away, but not before V shoots her again, this time with a missile. Doll herself is not found, however. Uzi whines and yells "I hate it here!"

The camera transitions to the winter wasteland that is Copper 9, as a lone Worker Drone, Reid, looks for something. He finds his "excuse to be outside right now", that being his glasses. Reid then hears something in the distance, then looks up to the sky and sees a flash, which turned out to be a Disassembly Drone Landing Pod coming straight towards him. Reid manages to dodge the pod as it crashes, as more debris fly towards him. He looks up to see another Landing Pod nearby, this time landing more gracefully, latching onto the decayed buildings and landing properly. A human jumps out, pulling out a sword and immediately slicing off Reid's head. The human is then revealed to be none other than Tessa, now an adult woman who works for JCJenson as a Certified Technician.

Tessa says "Righty-o, work to do, eh J?" as a fully reconstructed J flies next to her. J gives her a key with a key chain of the Earth as she notes "Maintenance work", the Landing Pod beeping like a car. The scene pans out to the two Landing Pods with Tessa and J in the distance, as they all get completely obscured by a winter storm.

The episode opens on a sign which says "Camp 98.7". Uzi and her classmates arrive in a traditional school bus, with a man riding the vehicle, as if it were to be a horse carriage, which also had a red "X" marked on the fuel filler, indicating that it may not even have run on gas. Uzi steps off last, holding her normal skull bracelet with a flower pattern and Doll's bracelet with another skull on it.

The scene cuts to a flashback where Khan Doorman shows Uzi an old photo of Camp 98.7. It zooms in on two drones' necks with collars on them, one with the ID 048 and the other with 002. The collars have a skull, similar to to Uzi and Doll's bracelets. Khan tells Uzi how her mother would always tell him to build doors "against the coming sky demons", referring to the Disassembly Drones. He tells Uzi to be safe and gives her the bracelet she normally wears on her neck.

The camera then cuts back to the camp scene and shows Uzi looking at the collars. She puts one of them on. A student asks the teacher what the field trip is for, and the teacher tells him to ask Uzi. The student asks, "Who?" and Uzi replies that she's sat next to him for years. Everyone turns to look at her before jumping back and gasping. She says that she wanted to come alone, but that the teacher brought the other students on the trip due to his frustration with the class's test scores.

The aforementioned student questions whether the class is just going to be unsupervised, V and N land, wearing camp uniforms that seem to be for summer although it is currently winter at the campsite. N welcomes them and starts counting "One, two", pointing at V and himself and expecting the class to continue. When everyone just stands silently, frightened, V shoots one of them dead, prompting the rest to say their numbers in unison. N says that they have many "distracting activities" planned and tells them not to "run away to investigate stuff." He tells the class to go to the bunks, but everyone remains there, petrified. Thad is the first one to walk towards the Disassembly Drones. Lizzy who was stealing from the dead body is second, throwing what she had taken at V. The two stand next to N and V.

Uzi then does some sign language which presumably means, “Please, may I ditch these people?” N proceeds further and nods, Uzi travels further into the forest and arrives at a cabin. Uzi proceeds to look in a glass pane, revealing her reflection (as seen in Episode 2, reflections make the AbsoluteSolver break the reflection). She then panics as the glass breaks, puts down her bag and proceeds to use her AbsoluteSolver abilities. She then hears a scream from outside, but it's just her classmates, having fun setting up camp. Uzi starts overheating and goes to eat the oil in her bag (from Episode 3 in Doll's room). V stumbles across Uzi and says, "You said this camp would help us find that Red Eyed Doll Freak (Doll)." V proceeds to tell Uzi that she will be the next one she will kill and goes away. While is Uzi investigating the house, she finds a green variant of the robotic bugs seen in Episode 3. It opens up what is assumed to be a holographic chat, and while Uzi is communicating with it, Doll appears for a split second and then disappears.

Uzi returns to the campsite, where one of the drones is so surprised that they accidentally shoot her with an arrow. She uses the AbsoluteSolver to stop the arrow, however, after a second it explodes into oil and begins to mutate into an organic being. Everybody is horrified, and V attempts to kill Uzi. She runs away to a second cabin.

Uzi proceeds to close off all exits to the cabin. The lights that are on appear to hurt her (perhaps as a side effect) and she tries to turn them off. One of them fills with an unknown liquid and mutates, similar to the arrow. N gets mad at V and questions her about the lack of information she is giving him. N flies off, and V tells the surviving campers that they can do anything they want, and V leaves.

Rebecca and Darren sneak off, presumably to make out and coincidentally choose the same cabin that Uzi was currently in. Uzi finds them, eats Darren alive, while Rebecca escapes with half of her body after being bisected by Uzi. N goes into yet another cabin, and picks up VHS tapes, which was titled, "ZOMBIE DRONES!", and has a flashback of an unknown drone (probably a zombie) and a black hole-ish thing with a [null] in the center next to the ruined mansion seen at the start of Heartbeat, which he takes them with him.

Back at the camp, the campers find that Rebecca has been torn apart. She attempts to tell them that Uzi did this, but she doesn't remember her name, giving unclear information about her. Uzi appears, as Rebecca dies, and still the campers don't really seem to remember her name. One of the campers (Braiden) seeing Uzi, said unsurely, "oh, you...". She has undergone a transformation imitating the Disassembly Drones, with strange organic wings and a sentient tail, and visor symbols which switch from an "X" to the AbsoluteSolver symbol. The campers split up, all being killed by Uzi except for Lizzy, as V protects her. V knocks Uzi down, and says, "New body, same horrors. Huh, Cyn?" Uzi regenerates and fights V; in the ensuing fiasco, Lizzy, who had not bothered to run away, gets blasted away by a missile launched by V, though she survives. Uzi manages to sever V's tail and tries to stab her with it, but N stops her from doing so. Uzi stabs N with it, before realizing what she had done, but N is unfazed and gives her a smile before tossing her up into the sky. He then helps to comfort Uzi and to return her to her original form, before N lands with the normal Uzi in his arms. The survivors return to the bus and they leave the camp. The teacher asks V why some of the students are missing, who takes the blame for Uzi's rampage, though the teacher doesn't really care regardless.

On the bus, the sun rises and burns Uzi's hand, until N pulls it out of the light. As he does, Uzi briefly holds it, which sends him in shock and pulls it away, and the camera pans to the VHS tapes (which say "ZOMBIE DRONES!"), ending the episode.

The episode starts with a JCJenson training VHS tape on Worker Drones, and why and how one should dispose of one if it's no longer effective, with the tape eventually warning about "Zombie Drones," drones that have suddenly self-rebooted long after disposal due to failure to uphold proper disposing guidelines. The VHS gets cut out to show a pile of dead drones and a crow pecking out some of the wires. The inside of the pile is then shown, inside which a deactivated Worker Drone self-reboots, becoming a "Zombie Drone", and is shown looking around looking shaken and confused, surrounded by dead drones, before the camera cuts away to Elliott Manor.

Inside the manor are many motionless Worker Drones in various different poses, coming to the library. N is happily reading a book about dogs, a motionless V standing nearby. Then, a group of thumping noises are heard, and N puts down his book to investigate. Then the basement starts banging, something trying to force the door open. Seconds later, several books fall from the shelves, reading "Danger", "Enter", and "The Spooky Basement". N disregards these books, and decides to leave the library to continue with his duties. He walks to the bar and has a small conversation with another Worker Drone named Cyn, who seems awkward in her own body. Cyn brings up the gala that's happening at the manor. She makes it clear she wants to go with her adoptive brother, but N claims it's just not possible. But while wiping a sudden splatter of blood off his platter, he sees the words "BASEMENT NOW!!! STOP IGNORING ME!!!! >:(" reflected. After throwing away the plate in shock, he agrees to ask Tessa if they can come to the gala, after Cyn gives him the puppy eyes. (A literal picture of a puppy she displayed on her optics screen).

The two then head to the dining hall, where they see multiple Worker Drones setting up the furniture, with a blacked-out person (James) scolding two of them, before throwing a fork into one of them, killing it. They also see J and Tessa talking to each other, with Tessa excited about the gala, but nervous as she'd never spoken to many other humans. While she happily greets and hugs N, N notices a message being written out on the window that says: "WHEN U ABOUT 2 FRIKKEN DIE. SPEAK ALOUD. ID: DarkXWolf17".

Before he could say much of anything, Tessa notices Cyn. Cyn informs her that J forgot to let her out of her basement again. Tessa's mother (Louisa Elliott) then comes over, scolding Tessa for bringing out the drones again and declaring that the three of them will be thrown out as well for not locking up Cyn. Tessa apologizes, obviously uncomfortable speaking to her mother. Cyn speaks up, telling Louisa that they aren't broken, and no matter what, they can't be thrown out. But before Louisa could do anything to her, N quickly jumped to her defense and took the blame for Cyn's behavior.

This leads to N being taken outside, where a flock of crows peck at him. He at first screams, but then laughs at their behavior. He then throws a stick to drive their attention away, but another crow grabs it mid-air, causing the crows to peck at him again. N, quickly remembering the message on the window, shouts: "DarkXWolf17". Almost all of the crows fly away- except for one that remained standing still. A lightning strike flashes, the crow's shadow briefly taking an image of the AbsoluteSolver icon, before convulsing, its cracking bones resting, before collapsing on the ground. The crow gets up, a purple AbsoluteSolver icon in it's eyes. Suddenly, a user tag with the name "DarkXWolf17" appears above its head. Uzi's voice speaks to N from the crow, revealing that she now has complete control over it, and has now accessed N's mind and memories.

Back in the manor, Tessa is seen in her bedroom with a chain latched to her leg, begging Cyn and J to help her free. But J refuses due to orders, and Cyn appears to be playing with dolls. However, while looking over the chain, Cyn appears right next to her (now with the appearance of an Eldritch), informing her since she doesn't get rid of them, she won't do the same with her. Before escaping through the window, she advises a shocked Tessa and J not to go to the gala, as she believes Tessa is squeamish.

Back outside, Crow Uzi tells N that his future self passed out because of a program, and that his past memories were being deleted. She warns N that they need to restore his past memory before he gets digitally lobotomized. She then instructs him to go to the library basement; however, the crow then shouts for its "dad" to get out of their room. It's revealed that in the present time, Khan Doorman has entered Uzi's room to check on her. N and V are also seen lying on the ground with Xs on their eyes, inert. Uzi, embarrassed by her father's reaction to "her having friends over", vents at him and locks him out with her AbsoluteSolver powers, before retaking control of the crow.

Uzi and N then arrive at the entrance of the manor, to a horrific scene of blood and parts. They find the still deactivated V standing still, a flash of lightning illuminates the wall, showing a pair of wings and splattered blood everywhere. N, panicked, having hesitation about going further, but Crow Uzi informs him that if they leave, his memories will be erased, and that they are important to her and to him.

N, frightened of the ambiance, refuses to move closer, so an annoyed Uzi tugs him forward. N moves the motionless drone aside and lifts the rug up, revealing the basement to be locked. The two groan, realizing the key is with J, until they hear someone giggle. They look over to V, who is now grinning sadistically, and wielding a claw-like hand.

Back in Tessa's bedroom, J is working to bite off Tessa's chains and free her. Realizing that Cyn is planning to kill everyone at the gala, the two quickly leave the room, quietly tip-toeing across the hallway in order to put a stop to her. After Tessa bumps into a suit of armor, she and J think to bring some weapons with them for protection. (A sword and a gun, respectively, which they immediately trade.) N and Crow Uzi then appear, and motion for the other two to lay low- V is on the prowl, crawling on the ceiling with a large pair of leathery wings. The four group together, ready for an attack, with N telling Tessa they need the key to the basement. Crow Uzi then grabs the key, while mocking Past J. Before long, V jumps down and starts to attack the trio. J instructed N and Crow Uzi to quickly go to the basement while she and Tessa stall V. V attempts to grab the key from N, but is quickly stopped by J before she could lay a claw on him. While a puzzled and angered James comments on the "tomfoolery".

N then heads off into the manor and opens up the basement, but as soon as he unlocks it, An Eldritch Cyn appears from the basement and hits Crow Uzi, destroying the crow, and proceeds to grab N's leg. The Eldritch all of a sudden stops, and changes its eyes from yellow to purple, Uzi taking control over it. When V returns, she grabs N and they scan the basement for clues. They discover the mutilated corpses of other unfortunate Worker Drones before coming across the decapitated N sitting in a chair. The two quickly agree it was time to leave, having found what they'd been looking for, when they heard another loud noise. Uzi loses control of the Eldritch and is wrenched out of N's mind.

The thumping sounds continue with her father asking Uzi about Doll being present in the house. And before long, she appears right in front of her! Back in the flashback, N unfortunately gets captured by the Eldritch and is placed in the chair. Meanwhile back upstairs, the gala is about to begin with James commencing it. However, Cyn appears right in front of the guests ready to attack. But luckily, J and Tessa arrived to put an end to the yet-to-be massacre. James and Louisa scold their daughter for her tomfoolery, but are immediately pushed aside by the AbsoluteSolver. Tessa then tries to stop Cyn by throwing several different objects at her but to no avail. Cyn then tell her she didn't have to witness this. And by using the AbsoluteSolver, she was able to control all of the drones in the building including J to massacre everyone in the dining room. As N hears the bloodcurdling screams of the guests, the Eldritch tries to grab some nearby tools to get rid of N's memories. But when it couldn't, it calls for V to help out, but also couldn't do it. Back in the present, Doll and Uzi continue to fight each other, but when Uzi noticed that N is in danger, she quickly forks over the key (green bug that Uzi found in episode 4) in the hopes it would leave her and the others alone. It works, Doll then thanks Khan for raising a good daughter before teleporting away.

Back in the memory, N proceeds to give V her glasses back in the hopes it can help V pick up the scalpel. As N proceeds to accept his fate, V luckily regains part of her memory and tries to symphantize with him. But immediately gets stopped by the Eldritch who plans to use more threatening tools on him. But luckily, Uzi is able to regain control over the Eldritch before it can wipe his memories out and was able to save V as well. Now N realizing Uzi was helping him this entire time, thanks her for saving him. But V gets angry at her and wakes herself and N from the trance. V threatens Uzi with chainsaws.

Doll then teleports outside where she meets with J and Tessa where they are given the key. She asks them to take her with them, but is shot at by Tessa to make sure she isn't going to betray them. But as they turn around, Uzi, N, and V were right in front of them. The episode ends with the group ready to attack each other, ending on a cliffhanger.

The episode opens at Cabin Fever Labs, where Worker Drone 029 tries to both hide herself and retrieve a Worker Drone who is "bootlooped" (a state resembling paralysis) from Sentinels. Unfortunately, the velociraptor-like Sentinels tear the Drone apart, and another Sentinel closes on in her, bootloops her with a flashlight, and eventually kills 029, ripping her to pieces.

Meanwhile, Uzi, N, and V meet up with Tessa and J. As Tessa explains why she and J are in Copper 9, Doll steals the keybug she had given them earlier and flees with it, prompting the group to give chase; however, Doll escapes by hopping into a hole leading to the Labs. Uzi, N, V, and Tessa venture inside the Labs while J stays behind to safekeep Tessa's ship. The foursome finds the entrance to the Labs, which is full of Disassembly Drones corpses. When they find the route to the secret elevator, Tessa is dragged away by a trap. Uzi, N, and V follow her, finding a spider baby Worker Drone. N attempts to shoot the spider baby, but it escapes. Suddenly, a female Worker Drone appears with the spider baby, just as an EMP pulse knocks Uzi, N, and V out.

Uzi wakes up in a hospital room, where the female Worker Drone, named Alice, beheads a paralyzed Worker Drone, revealing her scavenger nature, taking parts of both Worker and Disassembly Drones for herself. She keeps the biomechanical cores of the latter inside an oven, which she claims “slows them down,” apparently similar to paralysis. While she is talking, Alice mentions that Nori "left them to die", shocking Uzi. Meanwhile, in a room where N and Tessa are kept, Beau, the spider baby drone, is performing surgery on N, who is incredibly unfazed about being cut open. Beau is called over by Alice for more "sedatives" - which are actually magnets to negate Uzi's AbsoluteSolver powers. Tessa seizes the chance to escape with N, and the two head to save Uzi and V. On the way, Tessa gives N a look at Earth, which, albeit off-screen, leaves him stunned. Alice, finding out N and Tessa escaped, releases a group of Sentinels locked in cages, intending for the dinosaur robots to kill the two.

The picture of Earth that Tessa showed to N is finally revealed, showing that the planet is blown up. Tessa explains it was because Cyn being infected by the Solver, and that the Solver spreads through multiple planetary systems; the humans of Copper 9 attempted to find out what was happening by establishing the Cabin Fever Labs, but instead spread the Solver even more through Worker Drones like Yeva or Nori. She also tells him that he must choose either the universe or Uzi, something that afflicts N, since he doesn't want Uzi to be killed, but rather fixed. Just then, a Sentinel arrives and bootloops N, but when it was about to kill him, Tessa attempts to intervene by having the Sentinel trust her. However, the Sentinel instead bites her arm. This causes the Sentinel to apparently kill itself, having violated its programming. More Sentinels start to close on Tessa while Alice gleefully watches. She then notices everything in the room is floating, and turns to find Uzi, temporarily possessed by the AbsoluteSolver. Uzi then creates a black hole (surrounded by suspicious organic matter), destroying the door controls to Alice's safe room; Uzi falls unconscious shortly after.

The Sentinels notice the door to Alice's room is open and arrive just as Alice was trying to close them. The Sentinels break in, killing Alice, and try to kill Uzi too, but are distracted by Beau charging up a laser beam. However, Beau uses it to free V at the cost of his own life. V is cornered by Sentinels, but they are consumed by the black hole, and she flees with Uzi. N wakes up from his bootloop as V and Uzi reunite with him and Tessa, who is berated by V about the control she claimed to have over the Sentinels. Tessa tells N she hasn't “been quite honest with V yet.” Uzi wakes up and hugs N, while V stares ominously at Tessa. Meanwhile, the Sentinel who had wounded Tessa's arm reboots as a red-eyed variant, now able to attack anything that moves.

The foursome flee and lead the Sentinels down into a long hallway where the secret elevator is. To their surprise, Doll lays in a bootloop state, having apparently been done in by Sentinels; as they walk, Uzi and N are both blushing and holding hands. Doll, however, had faked her bootloop state (via a GIF) to lure the group into the hallway; she steals the keybug back, and (dropping a lift in the way to cut them off from chasing her) leaves them trapped with Sentinels. Tessa distracts the Sentinels away from the group with her blood, calling, “Oops! I hope I don’t human everywhere!” but the red-eyed Sentinel arrives, no longer affected by human blood. Uzi tries to use her Solver powers to open a hole in the lift, but it ends up opening another black hole which she cannot control. The red-eyed Sentinel uses a dismembered Disassembly Drone’s arm gun to shoot Tessa, but V manages to catch the bullet, and proceeds to battle the Sentinel who fired it, using a pair of glasses to negate its flash attack. While V fights the Sentinel, N, seeing that Uzi is not able to stop the black hole from growing, severs her arm, stopping the hole. Tessa, N, and Uzi enter the falling lift from the black hole's remnants as V manages to defeat the red-eyed Sentinel. However, another Sentinel causes the lift to ascend, and V is slowly surrounded by more Sentinels, still unable to join the others.

V ultimately makes the decision to cut the cables, to N's protests, instead voicing her trust in Uzi as the elevator car begins to drop. As Tessa, Uzi, and N and sent plummeting down the shaft, V stands tall, saluting her friends as the Sentinels close in, but the cut to black leaves her fate currently unknown as the elevator plunges down the shaft.

She was one of the Worker Drone servants working at Elliott Manor before the collapse of Copper 9. She was separated from the other Workers, such as J, V and N and locked in the library basement because of her atypical behavior. Her improper disposal resulted in her resurrection as a Zombie Drone, allowing the AbsoluteSolver to manifest within her. She is the first known host of the Solver.

It was later revealed by J and Tessa in "Dead End" that after Cyn massacred the gala during Home, she disappeared from Earth. Cyn also transformed N, V, and J into Disassembly Drones and reformed their memories, then sent clones of them to Copper 9 with fake orders from JCJenson to kill all the Worker Drones present on Copper 9. The trio is not told the reason for this, nor are they allowed to question.

Despite her disappearance and the unknown status of her physical form, it was later revealed to N by Tessa that Cyn wasn't controlling the Absolute Solver. Instead, the Absolute Solver infected Cyn as its first host and has been using her for its unknown agenda, a part of which included destroying the Earth and other exoplanets, intent on wiping out humanity.

Before the events of the series, Cyn was a Worker Drone that was marked for decommissioning but was improperly disposed of. This failure of her disposers to uphold proper disassembly procedures led to her suddenly self-rebooting at the bottom of a junkyard filled with decommissioned Worker Drones, causing Cyn to become the first known Zombie Drone. She eventually escaped the corpse pile and was adopted by Tessa to work at Elliott Manor, not realizing the other entity hiding with her programming.

Humans were the former dominant species on Copper 9, an exoplanet owned by JCJenson before an accident within the planetary core caused all biological life to be wiped out, due to the inhospitable conditions. They mainly worked under JCJenson as employees, supervising and mistreating the Worker Drones.

As of Dead End, humanity's status is left questionable as we see that Earth has been left completely inhospitable for life due to the Absolute Solver destroying it with a singularity, before the program spread to the drones inhabiting several other exo-planets colonized by humans, the most notable being Copper 9 with its infection of Nori Doorman.

Although there may be surviving humans elsewhere, Tessa Elliott is the only human confirmed to still be alive.
